text.tspan: Green apply = the API accepted it, not "it works"
Usual gaps: provider defaults you didn't set (target group health path "/") · ignore_changes hiding a field ·
user_data runs only at first boot · missing dependency (IAM attached after the instance started) · IAM eventual consistency ·
lookup() default used silently · two resources managing the same thing (inline SG rules + separate rule resources) ·
someone changed it in the console after apply
TF_LOG=DEBUG TF_LOG_PATH=./tf.log terraform apply shows every API request/response (may contain secrets).
terraform console evaluates expressions · aws iam simulate-principal-policy tests permissions · Reachability Analyzer tests paths.
check { data "http" … assert { … } } runs on every plan/apply (1.5+).
